summary: Pacific Oak Strategic Opportunity REIT filed an 8-K reporting the abrupt resignation of four directors (Laurent Degryse, William Petak, Keith Hall, Peter McMillan III) effective June 15, 2026, followed by the appointment of Bradley E. Scher as Chairman, President, and CEO on June 18, 2026. Kenneth Yee resigned from the Board on the same date. No disagreement was cited. Scher, founder of Ocean Ridge Capital Advisors, has extensive restructuring and special-situations experience. The mass board departure and appointment of a restructuring-focused CEO signal a strategic shift. Watch for potential asset sales, refinancing, or a broader corporate reorganization.
